summary: Verified 3 change requests (no-demo-data, clickable Huddle mini-cards -> celebrations list, revamped Schedule page) plus regressions. 11/11 backend pytest cases (test_changes.py) pass; frontend Playwright flow passes end-to-end on mobile viewport (390x844) with real admin login on the deployed URL. Admin bday/start_date restored to empty (null-ish) after test.

minor.issue: MeUpdate is Optional[str]=None and update logic only sets non-None values, so a client cannot POST an explicit JSON null to clear birthday/start_date. Empty string ("") works as a de-facto null (parse_month_day() and anniversaries both treat falsy as missing), but the DB now stores 'birthday':'' / 'start_date':'' instead of null. Consider special-casing empty string -> $unset or supporting explicit null. Not user-visible today.

action_items: OPTIONAL: allow PATCH /api/me to clear birthday/start_date via JSON null (would keep DB clean instead of storing empty strings).
PREVIOUS iteration_1 unresolved: brute-force lockout key by proxy IP+email still splits counters across ingress pods (see iteration_1 rca).
critical_code_review_comments: Celebrations.jsx: useEffect deps disabled via eslint-disable but the effect uses cfg.endpoint indirectly through `type` — fine, but relying on eslint-disable-line is a smell.

Schedule.jsx: `data` for each period is loaded serially via Promise.all — good. The `Loading` state resets to true on every load() call, so switching tabs causes a full spinner even though data for other tabs is cached; consider tab-scoped loading.
Huddle.jsx: bdays/annis fetched with default window (=28) on the dashboard card, but the celebrations list uses window=366. That mismatch is intentional and correct.
Backend anniversaries: uses `sd.replace(year=today.year)` which will ValueError on Feb 29 start dates in non-leap years — wrap in try/except like birthdays does.
server.py MeUpdate — see minor issue above about null-clearing.

success_rate.backend: 100% (11/11 for change requests; prior iteration_1 34/35 unchanged)
